friends.name: John Williams
friends.role: Tenant farmer at Great House; juror of the Bute court leet. Succeeded his father in the tenancy in 1855 (1904 press report; identification is an inference).

friends.name: John Williams
friends.role: Father of Mary (Nancy) Williams, formerly Buckler; took over both tenancies in 1908; yearly tenant of the whole farm from 1916; tenancy surrendered 1949.

friends.name: Mary (Nancy) Williams
friends.role: Lived at the farmhouse; married Frederick Buckler in 1936; pleaded ownership in her defence to the 1974 action; witness statement c. 1974.

friends.name: Frederick Buckler
friends.role: Joined Mary (Nancy) Williams at the farmhouse on their marriage in 1936; ran the farm from 1944.

friends.name: William (Billy) Buckler
friends.role: Born at the farm on 25 August 1948; inherited in 1983; defendant in BP Properties Ltd v Buckler.

friends.name: J B W McDonnell QC and M Jarman
friends.role: Counsel for William Buckler in the Court of Appeal (published judgment).

friends.name: The Bute Estate (Marquesses of Bute)
friends.role: Landlord of Tŷ Mawr; 1824 estate survey; 1916 yearly tenancy; reversion conveyed to Western Ground Rents in 1938.

friends.name: Rev. H. H. Rickards
friends.role: Owner of the glebe land rated to John Williams (Llandough poor rate, 1872).

friends.name: Daniel Thomas & Son / Alfred Thomas
friends.role: Lime kiln and quarry at Llandough; 1877 sale reported in Mary (Nancy) Williams’s statement; final rent c. 1928.

friends.name: Lord Colum Crichton-Stuart
friends.role: Left Leckwith-with-Llandough under the 3rd Marquess of Bute’s will (press reports, 1900).

friends.name: Stephenson & Alexander
friends.role: Auctioneers of the Marquess of Bute’s coppice woods, including Cwm Cydfin Wood (1902).

friends.name: Western Ground Rents Ltd
friends.role: Landlord from 1938; 1939 revised tenancy; 1955 and 1962 possession orders; sold Parcel B (and an interest in the 1962 order on Parcel A) to BP Pension Trust 1969.

friends.name: Mr Knapp
friends.role: Landlords’ agent named in Mary (Nancy) Williams’s statement about the missing family papers (1950–52).

friends.name: BP Pension Trust
friends.role: Bought from Western Ground Rents (31 Dec 1969); conveyed to BP Properties (1975, 1982).

friends.name: Forest of Cardiff
friends.role: Woodland WA735527 transferred to it, 10 Nov 1994.

friends.name: BP Properties Ltd
friends.role: Plaintiff in BP Properties Ltd v Buckler; first registration WA231076 (1982); transferred to Ideal Homes 1993.

friends.name: Linklaters & Paines
friends.role: Solicitors for BP Properties (Court of Appeal report; HM Land Registry letter of 23 Mar 2026).

friends.name: Paul Morgan (counsel)
friends.role: Counsel for BP Properties in the Court of Appeal (published judgment).

friends.name: Debenham Tewson
friends.role: Named as “the agents for BP Properties” in Llandough Community Council minutes (1987).

friends.name: Ideal Homes
friends.role: Bought from BP Properties, 3 December 1993; built the houses.

friends.name: Persimmon
friends.role: Correspondence on the title file (1995–96).

friends.name: High Court (1955)
friends.role: Possession order against Frederick Buckler alone, worded for the whole farm, 2 Feb 1955.

friends.name: Cardiff County Court
friends.role: 1962 order for the farmhouse/buildings/garden group (not enforced).

friends.name: Hollis J (High Court)
friends.role: Heard the case at Cardiff on 10 July 1986; judgment for BP on 24 July 1986.

friends.name: Dillon LJ
friends.role: Gave the leading judgment in the Court of Appeal, 31 July 1987.
friends.kind: Person · Lord Justice of Appeal (public role)

friends.name: Mustill LJ
friends.role: Agreed, Court of Appeal, 31 July 1987.
friends.kind: Person · Lord Justice of Appeal (public role)

friends.name: Sir Edward Eveleigh
friends.role: Agreed, Court of Appeal, 31 July 1987.

friends.name: House of Lords
friends.role: Refused leave to appeal, 3 March 1988.

friends.name: Judge Norman Francis
friends.role: Refused to continue the injunction pending the ECHR application, 5 December 1988.

friends.name: European Commission of Human Rights
friends.role: Application of 3 May 1988 declared inadmissible, 14 April 1989.

friends.name: National Library of Wales
friends.role: Welsh Newspapers Online; title-deeds lists.

friends.name: Cardiff council
friends.role: Received c. 109 acres of Leckwith Woods from Western Ground Rents (1940–42).

friends.name: The National Archives
friends.role: National Farm Survey (MAF 32) and the 1958 inquiry record (BD 28/177).

friends.name: WAEC (War Agricultural Executive Committee)
friends.role: Dissatisfied with the farm in 1944 (Mary (Nancy) Williams’s statement).

friends.name: Glamorgan County Council
friends.role: Development Plan (Area No. 2) public inquiry, 1958.

friends.name: GGAT (now Heneb)
friends.role: Glamorgan-Gwent Archaeological Trust: 1982 recommendation, 1990 assessment and field evaluation; 2026 records request to Heneb.

friends.name: Ted Rowlands MP
friends.role: Raised the BP pension fund and Western Ground Rents in the Commons, 22 May 1980.
friends.kind: Person · MP for Merthyr Tydfil (public role)

friends.name: HM Land Registry
friends.role: First registrations WA231076 (1982) and WA240304 (1983), amalgamated; 2026 complaint, FOI and alteration application.

friends.name: Llandough Community Council
friends.role: Minutes of 1987; correspondence 2025–26.

friends.name: Cadw
friends.role: Inspected the farmhouse for listing, 29 July 1988; declined to list; 2026 ATISN answers.

friends.name: Welsh Office / Welsh Government
friends.role: Cadw’s parent department; answers access-to-information requests (ATISN 27021, 26-0010, 27589).

friends.name: Alun Michael MP
friends.role: Asked the Lord Chancellor to look at the case (South Wales Echo, 12 May 1988).
friends.kind: Person · MP for Cardiff South and Penarth, 1988 (public role)

friends.name: Home Office
friends.role: Licence to remove human remains, 21 March 1994.

friends.name: Glamorgan Archives
friends.role: Holds the Bute estate survey (DB/E/1) and the 1982 council minutes.

friends.name: Cllr George Carroll
friends.role: Vale of Glamorgan councillor; correspondence 2025–26.
friends.kind: Person · Vale of Glamorgan councillor (public role)

friends.name: Kanishka Narayan MP
friends.role: Sent a report on the case (14 Nov 2025).

friends.name: HM Land Registry Independent Complaints Reviewer
friends.role: Complaint ICR/090/26 allocated (2026).

friends.name: South Wales Police
friends.role: FOI 719/26: “hold no information” (2026).

friends.role: Excavated the early-medieval cemetery (1994).

friends.role: Reports of 1958 and 6 December 1988.

friends.name: Daily Telegraph
friends.role: “‘Open day’ to save ancient Welsh house”, 16 April 1974.

friends.role: Reported the 1988 eviction and demolition.

friends.name: Paul R. Egan
friends.role: Clerk to Llandough Community Council (public role); replies on behalf of the Council, 2025–26.
